title: Revealing Entanglement-Growth Mechanisms through the Magic Barrier
summary: Quantum entanglement and magic are complementary resources underlying quantum computational advantage, yet their dynamical relation in many-body systems remains poorly understood. In this Letter, we show that the mechanism of bipartite entanglement growth is encoded in the relative timescale between the entropy-growth-rate peak and the magic barrier, defined as the transient peak of the anti-flatness of the entanglement spectrum.
